steps.title: Configure Build Environment and Dependencies
steps.description: Configured Temurin 17, Gradle 8.5, Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2, compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, and Java 8 source compatibility.

steps.title: Set Up Application Metadata and Package Identifier
steps.description: Defined package name com.boxstockmanager.app and app_name Box Stock Manager in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest and System Permissions
steps.description: Configured permissions for Camera, Vibrator, and Storage along with standard Material theme activity registration.

steps.title: Update Product Scanner Model for Multi-Field Auto-Fill
steps.description: Enhanced ProductScannerResult model with fields for product name, category, prices, stock quantity, supplier, location, and description.

steps.title: Enhance OCR and Barcode Text Parsing Logic
steps.description: Implemented token-by-token and line-by-line label mapping (Name, Brand, Model, Code, IMEI, Category, Color, RAM, Storage, Prices, Qty, Supplier, Location, Description) supporting delimiters (:, =, -) and multi-line clean code extraction.

steps.title: Update Form Auto-Fill Logic in MainActivity
steps.description: Connected full scanner result mapping to Product Form fields without overwriting user-entered data or dumping multi-line data into single code fields.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Compiling and assembling final debug APK for Box Stock Manager using Gradle build system.
